params.name: menuBar
params.description: Number of the menu bar, or its name (Text), or a 16-character MenuRef menu ID (Text).

params.name: process
params.description: Process reference number whose menu bar is to be changed; if omitted, applies to the current process.
If passed, preserves the current enabled/disabled state of menu commands instead of reinitializing the menu bar.

interactionNotes.note: When menuBar is a MenuRef, both process and '*' are ignored.

constraints: A menu bar name may contain up to 31 characters and must be unique.
If menuBar is a MenuRef (menu ID), the process parameter serves no purpose and is ignored.
If menuBar is a MenuRef, the trailing '*' parameter serves no purpose and is ignored.
